recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, full-body portrait of a woman suspended from a trapeze bar against a vast, seamless blue gradient sky. The subject is wearing a black high-cut bodysuit, sunglasses, and stilettos, maintaining a poised, vertical athletic stance with one leg bent.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical alignment of the subject against a horizontal trapeze bar
High-contrast silhouette of black attire against a vibrant blue backdrop
Hard, direct lighting creating sharp highlights on skin and fabric
Symmetry of the trapeze chains framing the central figure
coreInvariants: Deep blue gradient background without clouds or horizon
Metallic trapeze bar with visible chain links
Glossy or satin finish on the black bodysuit

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally aligned, occupying the vertical middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal trapeze bar at the top third of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Vertical descent from the hands on the bar, down the torso, following the line of the legs to the pointed toe of the heel.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive blue negative space surrounding the subject on all sides, emphasizing isolation and height.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones with golden highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue channel; high value contrast between the dark subject and the bright sky.
paletteRestrictions: No green or red hues in the background

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution image of a woman with blonde hair in a black satin bodysuit and sunglasses, hanging from a silver trapeze bar. The background must be a clean, cloudless gradient of deep blue. Use hard, direct sunlight to create sharp shadows and highlights on her muscles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, wide-tracked sans-serif font placed in the lower third or upper corners to maintain the minimalist composition.

verificationChecks: Is the background a smooth gradient without artifacts?
Are the highlights on the skin sharp and defined?
Is the trapeze bar perfectly horizontal?

adjustableVariables: Texture of the bodysuit (matte vs. gloss)
Height of the trapeze bar in the frame
mustRedesign: Any specific facial features of the original subject
Specific brand logos on the sunglasses or shoes

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the silhouette

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the hanging pose
Ensure the chains are straight and under tension
Verify the blue gradient is free of banding
Confirm the lighting direction is consistent across the body and bar
recipe.reuseFormula: Central vertical subject + horizontal aerial apparatus + monochromatic high-contrast wardrobe + seamless sky gradient.
